text:
anya: pagerduty triggered for runtime crashloop on gpu-pool-7, high error rate from 03:02 UTC. Investigating.
pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3487. Paging eng-oncall.
liam: I'm on it, looking at k8s events for affected node pool. Can someone drop recent kubelet logs?
alex: attaching `kubectl describe pod runtime-serve-xx -n redwood-prod` excerpt: 
```
Events:
  Warning  BackOff  2m (x5 over 3m)  kubelet  Back-off restarting failed container
  Warning  Failed   2m (x4 over 3m)  kubelet  Error: containerd: container not started
```
liam: I see repeated segfault exits in container logs. Pulling last 200 lines: 
```
[2026-04-05T03:02:10Z] runtime-engine: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f9c4e12ab cd 0x7f9c4e12
[2026-04-05T03:02:10Z] vLLM: attention_fused_kernel.cu:142: fatal signal 11
[2026-04-05T03:02:10Z] CUDA error: unspecified launch failure (700)
```
anya: hmm CUDA 700 unspecified launch failure and SIGSEGV. Any driver resets on the node?
infra-bot: Node gpu-node-7 reported GPU watchdog reset at 03:02:11 UTC, GPU0.
jess: quick note — a deploy rolled out last night that included a micro-PR enabling fused attention kernels for some quantized paths. Could be related.
liam: good catch. Rolling back that feature at runtime level should be fast. Options: 1) patch deployment env var `REDWOOD_ENABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=false` and rollout; 2) scale down offending replicas to 0 then back to pick new config; 3) cordon + drain node to isolate hardware. Thoughts?
anya: we need customer impact estimate before taking disruptive actions. Telemetry?
alex: routing shows 12% of production requests served by gpu-pool-7 in last 5m; error rate on that pool spiked to 48% leading to ~6% end-to-end 5xxs across hosted API. Top customers affected: cust-A (5% of their queries), cust-B (10% of queries).
liam: I'll set env var and trigger a rolling restart of the runtime deployment (non-disruptive, keeps autoscaler). Doing `kubectl set env deployment/runtime --namespace=redwood-prod REDWOOD_ENABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=false --record` now.
liam: done. New pods are coming up. Monitoring logs for segfaults.
liam: initial pods restarted and are passing liveness checks. Error rate on gpu-pool-7 dropped from 48% -> 2% in 40s.
anya: excellent. Mark mitigation: runtime fallback to non-fused kernels. Can we confirm root cause before closing?
jess: ops and runtime team will reproduce with the release branch and a small perf test with quantized model to replicate segfault. Hypothesis: fused kernel not handling edge-case zero-len KV or odd-sized quantized tensors -> illegal memory read.
infra-bot: Noting node gpu-node-10 also had a single pod OOM earlier but that was unrelated (evicted due to mem limit).
liam: action items: 1) rollback fused kernel merge in canary and patch kernel to add bounds checks; 2) run a targeted test across all GPU types (A10/A100) with quantized models; 3) create post-incident runbook entry for fused kernel safe flags; 4) notify CS for affected customers with ETA.
anya: I'll draft a short customer-facing note and post to #customer-success.
liam: tagging oncall rotation for handoff in 30m to follow up on root cause: @jess will lead root cause, @alex infra will follow node telemetry and driver logs.
jess: capturing logs and core dump locations: `/var/crash/runtime-serve-xx/core.2026-04-05.030210` uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/INC-2026-3487/. Will share debug scripts.
liam: removing pager now. Please escalate if regressions appear.
anya: closing pager — mitigated by runtime flag rollback and pod restarts. Follow-up: postmortem scheduled 2026-04-05 12:00 UTC.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-3487 acknowledged, status: mitigated.
liam: final note for on-call handoff: monitor gpu-pool-7 for 1h, keep REDWOOD_ENABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=false until patch validated in staging.
anya: thanks everyone — good coord. :thumbsup:
